# ACT Organic
> Certification body for organic products in Thailand, providing standards, certification services, operator listings, and supporting documents.

ACT Organic helps operators obtain organic certification, access standards and application materials, use certification labels correctly, and verify certified, suspended, or canceled operators.

## Getting Started
- [Home](https://actorganic-cert.or.th): Main entry point for ACT Organic certification services, standards, news, and operator resources.
- [6 Steps To Certification](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/6-steps-to-certification): Overview of the certification process from application through inspection and approval.
- [Request Application](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/request-application): Application request page for operators seeking certification with ACT Organic.
- [Documents](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/documents): Downloadable forms, guidance, and supporting materials for certification applicants and operators.

## Standards and Certification Programs
- [Organic Standards](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/standard): Core organic standards and certification requirements used by ACT Organic.
- [Cosmetic and Healthcare products Standard](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/eu): Standard information for cosmetic and healthcare product certification programs.
- [6 Steps To Certification](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/6-steps-to-certification): Process guide explaining how certification is conducted and managed.
- [Request Application](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/request-application): Start the certification process by requesting the relevant application materials.

## Services
- [Training](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/training): Training services and educational activities related to organic certification and compliance.
- [Labelling and seal use](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/labelling-and-sealing): Rules and guidance for using ACT Organic labels and certification seals.
- [Transaction Certificate](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/transaction-certificate): Information on transaction certificates for certified organic product trade.
- [Documents](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/documents): Reference documents and service-related forms for operators and applicants.

## Operator Lists
- [Certified Operator List](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/certified-operator-list): Public list of operators currently certified by ACT Organic.
- [Commercial Input Certified Operators List](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/commercial-input-certified-operators-list): List of certified commercial input operators recognized by ACT Organic.
- [Suspended Operators List](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/suspended-operators-list): Operators whose certification status is currently suspended.
- [Canceled Operators List](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/canceled-operators-list): Operators whose certification has been canceled or withdrawn.

## Organization
- [Organization](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/about-us): Overview of ACT Organic as an organization and certification body.
- [Staff](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/staff): Staff directory and team information for ACT Organic.

## Resources
- [Documents](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/documents): Central repository of downloadable certification documents and supporting files.
- [Organic Standards](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/standard): Official standards documentation for organic certification requirements.
- [Labelling and seal use](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/labelling-and-sealing): Practical guidance on compliant label and seal application.
- [Transaction Certificate](https://actorganic-cert.or.th/transaction-certificate): Resource page for transaction certificate procedures and requirements.
